gist.headline: Twenty-three apps get their portraits
gist.blurb: Twenty-three community apps now have screenshots in the catalog. Same apps, same details; more to look at before clicking through.
gist.summary: Added screenshots to 23 existing community app catalog entries without removing apps or changing other metadata.
gist.impact: Visitors can now preview 23 more community apps from their catalog entries.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community app gallery with newly filled picture frames represents the 23 catalog screenshots. Polli, wearing a tiny curator's beret, pins up a preview while pixel flowers grow around the display.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art community gallery, Polli wears a tiny curator's beret and pins colorful app screenshots onto a wall of chunky picture frames, with pixel flowers growing beneath them. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
